description: Send a message to one of your hosts and get its reply, in the host's own voice (it's warmer with you because it knows you're its creator). Get host_id from list_hosts.

host_id.description: The host's positive integer id (from list_hosts).

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key for an external retry. Leave unset for MCP-managed idempotency.

new_intent.description: Set true only to deliberately send the same text or topic again; normal retries reuse the prior operation for 24 hours.

text.description: Your message to the host (1-800 characters).

name: chat_with_host
title: Chat with one of your hosts
